name: @wae/open-mv-workspace
description: OpenMV — music-video authoring presets and skills over the OpenCut engine

scripts.presets: pnpm run build && node packages/open-mv/dist/cli/main.js presets
scripts.analyze: pnpm run build && node packages/open-mv/dist/cli/main.js analyze
scripts.render:lyric: pnpm run build && node packages/open-mv/dist/cli/main.js render films/lyric-mv.ts -o lyric-mv.mp4
scripts.render:beat: pnpm run build && node packages/open-mv/dist/cli/main.js render films/beat-mv.ts -o beat-mv.mp4
scripts.render:song: pnpm run build && node packages/open-mv/dist/cli/main.js render films/song-mv.ts -o song-mv.mp4
